messages:
olivia: FYI customer (ACME) escalated — A/B rollout dashboard shows Variant B at 75% while raw events show A at ~60%. Ticket #INC-45678. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/s/shot.png :thinking_face:

randall: copying in eng-analytics. do we have a quick repro? which experiment id?

olivia: exp_2026_q1_new_routing. timeframe: 2026-03-10 00:00 -> 2026-03-10 12:00 (UTC). Customer claims product behavior matches A majority.

matt: dug into raw ingestion -> event table has: A=4512, B=3120 for that window. dashboard shows A=1200, B=6318. that looks like either an aggregation error or the viz is joining the wrong table. attaching quick query I ran:
```sql
-- counts from raw events
SELECT assignment_variant AS variant, COUNT(*) AS ct
FROM raw_events
WHERE experiment_id = 'exp_2026_q1_new_routing'
  AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY ct DESC;
```

julia: I just checked the dashboard SQL. It aggregates from materialized view `ab_latest_assignments_mv` and then joins to metrics by `user_id`. We ran a schema rename last night (variant -> assignment_variant) but the MV rebuild job might have used the old mapping. if the MV has stale rows it can double-count when join cardinality >1.

olivia: can you confirm whether the MV was rebuilt after the schema change?

julia: looking at the deploy logs — we deployed the analytics migration at 2026-03-09T22:45Z. The rebuild job was scheduled but failed on the first attempt due to a transient S3 error; it retried and completed at 2026-03-10T13:05Z. that means the MV was stale for the entire window the customer reported.

matt: aha — stale MV means dashboard was reading partial assignments (some earlier snapshot) while raw_events are live. but why would the counts be swapped (B >> A) rather than just lower for A?

julia: plausible explanation: when the MV was partially populated it included multiple assignment records per user (old + new) because dedupe step didn't run. the dashboard query uses `FIRST_VALUE(variant)` without ordering; that can pick the wrong row (e.g., older B label) for many users, inflating B. basically a tie/dedup bug.

randall: that matches customer repro. they sent sample user ids where UI showed B but logs show A.

julia: proposed immediate actions:
• mark the MV as stale and force a rebuild now (will take ~45m).
• patch dashboard query to use `ORDER BY assignment_ts DESC` in the window function so it picks the latest assignment.
• add a temporary monitor that compares raw_events counts vs dashboard counts and alerts if delta > 15%.

olivia: go for the quick patch and MV rebuild. can we do a low-risk change to the dashboard first?

julia: yes — small SQL change, tested locally on a snapshot, pushed to canary dashboard. deploy-bot: deploy analytics-sql/patch-2026-03-10 to canary succeeded.

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed at 2026-03-10T14:02Z :white_check_mark:

matt: after canary, I ran the same counts against the canary query and the numbers now match raw_events (A ~4500, B ~3100). good sign.

ops-bot: materialized-view rebuild job started at 2026-03-10T14:15Z. ETA ~45m.

julia: once MV finishes I'll re-run the dashboard for the customer window and post final numbers. also going to open a postmortem and include root cause, timeline, and permanent fixes (better MV job retries, idempotent dedupe, and a drift alert).

olivia: please update ticket INC-45678 with timeline and ETA for final confirmation. ask CS to offer a credit if customer unhappy.

randall: noted, pinged CS with interim update.

julia: MV rebuild completed at 2026-03-10T15:05Z. final dashboard counts for the window: A=4523, B=3189. discrepancy resolved. postmortem will be filed later today.

olivia: awesome — pls add an action to add a data-drift check that compares raw event counts to dashboard counts nightly. :eyes: Thanks everyone.

matt: filing follow-up tasks: DRIFT-142 (nightly comparator), ANALYTICS-331 (make MV rebuild idempotent), ALERTS-78 (delta alert >15%).

olivia: closing loop with customer and marking ticket resolved after CS confirms.

julia: postmortem draft: https://redwood.example/postmortems/ab-mv-dedup-2026-03-10.md

olivia: nice work.
